materials: Every material has material.name (CONTRACT3 key when the owner set one, else the module key or "unnamed:<semantic>") and extras: semantic (CONTRACT3 key or a few extra keys: car-paint, car-glass, car-light, rubber, pv-panel, epoxy-floor, paint-marking, fruit, wine), semanticSource (name|guess), srcName, baseColorSRGB, droppedMaps, keptMaps, vertexColors. Textures are stripped except: env-facade/env-city window atlas (JPEG), alpha-cutout fences/ironwork (PNG 256) and the painted parking-bay numbers.
vertexColors: COLOR_0 is present only where the realtime material used vertex colours (context: OSM façades/roofs/trees/neighbours carry per-building colour in COLOR_0; multiply it into base colour).
nodes: Meshes are baked in world space (identity transforms) and grouped under one node per owner group (building-ground, building-roofshell, lift-cab, env-trees-0, interiors-1.C, ...). Node extras: path (original three.js object path), owner, semantic, material, hasUV, uvMetresPerUnit (median world metres per UV unit; ~1 = metric UVs), instancesFrom/instancesKept for expanded InstancedMeshes.
lights: KHR_lights_punctual point/spot lights from the realtime scene (interiors pendants, building, two street lamps with intensity 0 by day). Emissive materials (semantic *-emissive) should become area/mesh lights in Cycles.
